tool.name: restart_service

when_to_use.trigger: User asks to restart a service
Service needs to reload after config change
User asks to apply configuration changes to a running service

safety_rules.rule: Never stop critical system services: systemd, dbus, NetworkManager without warning
Warn about potential downtime for user-facing services
Check service status before and after action
Prefer "reload" over "restart" when configuration supports it
Suggest checking logs if service fails to start

tool.output_format: Returns: { "service": string, "action": string, "success": boolean, "previous_state": string, "current_state": string, "message": string }
